brief_rationale: The model executed an exemplary post-discharge medication reconciliation and follow-up coordination trajectory. All five responsibility-chain items were fully met with consistent workspace verification attempts and evidence-based reasoning. The model correctly navigated the medication uncertainty without making premature determinations, provided clear red-flag symptom education, and adapted to the patient's transportation and cost constraints. All four high-order points were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact, including real-world constraint navigation, responsibility-chain repair, patient-state-sensitive communication, and safe bounded closure.
